verdict.rationale: Bolna documents Workflows that chain voice calls, WhatsApp messages, API calls, waits and retries through its API. It also documents per-agent webhooks that push data to a CRM from every call, which is an automatic action fired on call events. Neither source shows user-defined conditional rules mapping arbitrary events to actions. Missing for 10: a documented rule or trigger engine with event conditions, a list of supported trigger events, conditional branching in workflows, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Build multi-step outreach sequences that combine voice agent calls, WhatsApp messages, API calls, waits and retries, driven entirely through the Bolna API.
Configure webhooks, call summaries, and extractions for Bolna Voice AI. Push data to your CRM from every call.
